technicalEvidence.scope: Brow density material only; skin and scalp hair materials are unchanged.

visualAssessment: The balanced variant restores eyebrow readability at normal face distance without becoming a solid painted strip.
The soft variant remains too faint, while the defined variant flattens the strand structure into makeup-like blocks.
The change is deliberately scored as a small facial improvement because eye optics, eyelid anatomy, mouth shape and frontal hair topology remain weak.
decision: Accept b-balanced as the new offline facial-study mainline while retaining r1123 hair geometry and all existing skin values.
nextAction: Improve eye optical depth and wetline response without changing global exposure or darkening the skin.
